A '''sabacc parlor''' was an establishment dedicated to [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] playing. Often sabacc parlors were frequented by [[Gambler/Legends|gamblers]] and criminals, and large amounts of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and other commodities (including valuable information) were at stake.

One such parlor was The [[Spyder]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], which was frequented by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] operatives as well as criminals like [[Kaa'to Leeachos]]. Other examples of sabacc parlors were [[The Even Cut Sabacc Parlor and Casino|The Even Cut]] and [[Juri's Sabacc Parlor]].
